title: GTA Online Halloween Weather Returns with Green Filter; Workaround Discovered
description: RockstarINTEL reports that GTA Online's Halloween weather has returned for 2026, applying a green-orange filter from 19:00 to 7:30 in-game time. Players have found a temporary workaround using apartments to disable the filter, and green-tint glasses in first-person reduce the effect.
youtubeTitle: GTA Online Halloween Weather Returns: How to Turn Off Green Filter
socialHook: GTA Online's Halloween weather is back with a green filter—here's how players are disabling it.

sections.heading: Halloween Weather Returns to GTA Online
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has re-enabled the Halloween weather event in GTA Online as of Friday, October 30, 2026. The weather applies a dark green and orange filter to all players between 19:00 and 7:30 in-game time, covering roughly half of each in-game day. The event was activated later than in previous years, arriving just before Halloween weekend and potentially lasting through Monday.

sections.heading: Player-Discovered Workaround to Disable Filter
paragraphs: Reddit user Glyphistaken found a temporary method to remove the Halloween filter: enter an apartment, then exit to see the filter disabled. The effect persists until the player completes a job or loads into a new GTA Online session. Another user, Outrageous-List-5118, noted that wearing green-tint glasses in first-person view heavily reduces the green filter. RockstarINTEL notes these are player discoveries, not official features.

sections.heading: Additional GTA 6 Updates Mentioned
paragraphs: The RockstarINTEL article also references 12 new GTA VI screenshots released separately and South Park airing gameplay footage showing Jason throwing dog poo at an NPC. These details are unrelated to the Halloween weather event but were included in the same report.
